review_description: The installation was completed professionally with no issues at all. The team was polite, tidy, and punctual throughout. The system works perfectly — great quality product and excellent customer support from start to finish. Highly recommended.
The installation hasn't happened, after signing the contract and paying the deposit I am eventually told (several weeks later) that the installation should happen early 2026.
We had LMS install our solar system previously, and now our battery. Their communication, reliability and workmanship was excellent on both occasions. Highly recommend.

I would like to thank Park, Georga, and all the boys who did the installation of my 16Kw Sigenergy Home Solar Battery system.Right from the the very start when Park came out to give me a quote, the information was clear, precise and without bias as to which system to use, but they did highly recommend the Sigenergy system as well as providing information and costing about the others.As I was after a system that would cut in immediately and automatically if we experienced a blackout, then the Sigenergy was the way to go for us.I paid my deposit, scheduled an installation date, got it installed by 3 amazing blokes who were so professional and polite, it was a great experience watching them do the work. In conjunction with the installation they explained and answered any questions I had about what they were doing so that I could understand how it all worked. Upon commissioning the System they showed me how to use the App, what all the graphs meant, how I could change the colours of the LEDs on the System etc, change times for heating the hot water , all with absolute professionalism.LMS Electrical in Slacks Creek would be my first and only call should you be considering installing a Home Solar Battery System. They have a 5 Star Rating for a reason and its easy to see why!!Would I recommend LMS Electrical, absolutely.

From first contact with LMS Electrical I have been most impressed with the quality of service. LMS were not the cheapest of the quotes provided however, I have complete confidence in the work. We had a previous 5kW system and now replaced with the larger array. The supporting software has been very informative showing us just how much energy is being used in the home together with a real time display of power generated by our solar.
We recommend this installer; the experience, value for money was excellent

Sales team reached out very quickly and organised a time. Went through what I wanted, and suggested a Sigenergy Stack, which I was looking at, but didn't mention. Quote was very clear on what was in and out, and on the day, team rocked up and did a stellar Job. Very happy.

The sales process was clear and honest. Office communication was on point.The installation team were amazing from start to finish. They arrived on time, were prepared, and motivated to work hard.Overall extremely impressed with LMS Electrical!

When contacting LMS for a quote, Ray did not just make a "vanilla" proposal like others, he asked me what I want to do and make suggestions for the upcoming battery rebate and the wholesale pricing model of the electricity provider AMBER, explaining the business model and differences to other VPP operators. Upon my concerns about what he suggested, he provided wholesale pricing from AEMO to validate his information. He furthermore introduced me to Sigenergy and their battery setup with all the futureproof technology built in, which competitors still try to catch up to.None of my questions and ideas put him off, no matter how strange they were, and he always came back with good or better advise.After accepting the quote I received a detailed "what happens next" leaflet, explaining what who needs do for a seamless installation.Grant and his Team made the installation a breeze. very knowledgeable, diligent and helpful for a stress-free process, explaining how everything works, commissioning it and setting our phones with a new APP to play with.Very happy with everything LMS Electrical provided and can 100% recommend them.

We've just had panels & a hybrid inverter installed by LMS. We had a roof restoration done at the same time. LMS advised on how best to manage that, and liaised with the roofing team to make sure it went smoothly. The team on site were prompt, friendly, tidy and professional and did not leave until they knew were happy and able to understand everything. Communications throughout the process were great and so far everything is working well.We were very happy with the process from start to finish, and are currently talking to LMS about a battery.
The sales person was brilliant, not pushy and came with the best price for exactly what we wanted.They were quick to install and placed it like they would in their own home. We were beyond impressed.

I recently had the pleasure of working with LMS Electrical for a solar system upgrade, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the outcome. They installed a Sigen hybrid inverter (10kW single phase) paired with a 17kW solar panel system and decommissioned my old solar setup and solar pool heating system. Their professionalism, patience, and expertise stood out throughout the process.One of the things I greatly appreciated about LMS Electrical was their willingness to work with me every step of the way, even though this wasn’t the most straightforward project. Initially, I had been considering a different inverter, but when I decided to go with the Sigen hybrid inverter, we had to wait for its approval from the CEC. Despite this delay, the team was always accommodating, proactive, and supportive, keeping me informed at every stage.On top of that, my roof posed a significant challenge - it’s anything but straightforward. What impressed me the most was their collaboration and attention to detail. They patiently worked through countless design options with me, ensuring we arrived at a solution that fit my technical requirements and aesthetic preferences.In the end, the quality of their workmanship and their dedication to providing the best possible outcome truly shone. The system they installed performs beautifully, and I’m delighted with the result.LMS Electrical is an outstanding choice if you’re looking for a solar installation company that genuinely goes above and beyond for its customers. Their knowledge, professionalism, and customer-first approach make them a pleasure to work with, even on projects like mine. Highly recommend!

We got 3 quotes from SolarQuotes and engaged with all 3. LMS had a smooth sales process and didn't use the STC expiry on 31st Dec as a pressure sales tactic like others. Their quote was very competitive for the hybrid solution.They installed 12.8kw system with hybrid inverter and battery, happy with their communication, service and quality of system.

Our project was panels plus inverter plus battery.We had a non-standard install on a sub-board in a shed, well away from the main grid connection box.Install team were very professional and after-install customer service was also excellent.Ultimately all objectives were met.We would use LMS again.

Luke done the quotes(done quite a few) and once we got past the fact I didn't want them on the north facing roof because of a winter shading issue, everything went smoothly with him coming up with some great ideas and multiple options so thanks for working with me Luke.Ended up with a great 10Kw panel/8Kw inverter east/west facing combo, on 3 separate roof panels that cranked out over 60Kw on it's first full day of operation. Gotta be happy with that!Tony and the boys turned up on time, great tidy install with all ceiling wires in conduit and P-clamped, no mess left on roof or in yard and making 7Kw by about 2.30.My advice is to talk to the installers and make sure you do some research yourself to understand what you are actually buying as some of the people quoting out there are a bit shonky.I plan on buying a battery later and wouldn't hesitate to go straight back to these blokes for the purchase/install.

LMS Electrical were the first to respond during the quoting process.Excellent communication from Luke offering three options available to suit our solar requirements, providing a good quality system at a very competitive cost.Installation of the new system by Tony and the team was professional and precise which also including the removal of the old 1.5kw system.LMS completed all the paperwork for connection to the grid and set up of the  APP for remote monitoring.The whole process went smooth from start to finish, up and running in no time at all.Would highly recommend LMS Electrical for your solar requirements.
LMS provided clear feedback from initial sales enquiry to install. Team did some great work. System is up and running and should suffice all our normal energy needs.

I enjoyed the collaborative nature of the quotation process, as we identified the solution that was the best fit for our property needs.There was (mostly) excellent communication through the quoting, scheduling and installation process, and I always felt confident in the capability of LMS Electrical.The photos (including drone shots) of the work performed were a helpful and reassuring bonus to the service.Post installation the system has performed seamlessly, and I am confident that it has the potential to pay back the capital invested in the time frame we anticipated.

LMS Electrical was the first to reply out of the 4 installers we contacted. They also offered the best price and supplied good quality components. Incredibly friendly and responsive communication. Professional and always kept us updated in a timely manner when things changed due to bad weather. I really appreciate that they didn’t try to upsell or add things we didn’t ask for. They listened to what we asked for and delivered it. Couldn’t be happier!

We had an absolutely fantastic experience from the beginning to the end with LMS Electrical!! We couldn't speak more highly of them, especially Luke our sales person and Tony, our lead installer on the day.Luke was helpful, friendly and never pushy. He was the only sales person I've come across that I've actually felt comfortable with, and who I could tell wasn't just focussed on the sale. While we appreciate selling solar is his job, it never felt like the only focus. A big part of it for us was not only quality products but "the vibe". We were looking for a company who we could trust and who would listen to us if we had questions or concerns. Without fail, we could contact Luke at anytime and he would get back to us. Our relationship with Luke started a couple of years before we actually committed to installing solar due to a variety of factors. It was his willingness to always be there even though he knew we weren't a "quick" sale, which really made us feel even more comfortable with LMS.We wanted solar on the shed (not the house), with it symmetrically aligned and evenly spaced. Aesthetically, it was extremely important to us that everything looked symmetrical, neat and tidy. LMS hit the mark perfectly. Tony and his team on the day did a fantastic job. Tony ran the show like a well oiled machine with everyone having their own jobs on site to complete the work order efficiently and to a high standard. We emphasised to Tony on the day that having a symmetrical even spread of panels was extremely important to us, and he reassured us that if anything had to change or wasn't working after measuring up, he would let us know. This gave us peace of mind that we could communicate properly together and wouldn't end up with something we didn't want.It all went perfectly on the day, and the final install looks perfect!!! Absolutely incredible. We're so thankful for not only the fantastic quality products, but the tidy workmanship and friendly service. LMS Electrical always communicated well and there was never a moment where we wondered what was happening. They were helpful in explaining the whole process (including pre-install and post-install) and managed expectations exceptionally well. All of the paperwork was filed efficiently to ensure the system was fully connected as quickly as possible.Highly recommend LMS Electrical, and wouldn't go elsewhere!

We recently had a solar health check and a PowerPoint installed, and we couldn't be happier with the service! From the start, Loryn was incredibly responsive and provided us with a detailed quote in no time. Her knowledge and professionalism set the tone for the entire experience.Once we moved forward, Paul came out to handle the installation, and he did a fantastic job! He was punctual, friendly, and clearly skilled at what he does.Overall, the team exceeded our expectations with their quality of work and customer service. We highly recommend them for anyone in need of solar services or installations!

Project involved removal of aged solar panels and replacement with more effective and efficient configuration in South East Queensland. LMS were very candid about what to expect, and provided comprehensive material to address all relevant questions. LMS team were prompt, professional and courteous in our dealings. LMS completed the panel installation for activation, and took extra time to test and take owners through the collection and monitoring software.System has operated in line with expectations, and I would commend LMS to others thinking of acquiring solar.

The sales team was knowledgeable and supportive albeit at first tried to sell me a whole new PV system to replace my 18 month old one.The support offered by the team was excellent.Everything fell into place and I now have a zero power bill.One improvement would be to run through the operation and use of the battery system.

I couldn’t be happier with the work Grant and his team conducted at my place to install panels and inverter. They were professional, courteous, polite and informative telling me exactly what was going on what they were doing and what I could expect. Would ABSOLUTELY recommend these guys to anyone else looking for a solar solution.

LMS were so easy to deal with from the quoting through to the installation.      Communication with everyone was great. The installation was done on time and was done very quickly.    Everything up and running within a few hours. Explained everything very well and showed me how to monitor everything via the app.Great company to deal with.

Sales Rep was a pleasure to deal with had all the information I required knew the products and gave me options. Installation done in a day, was professional everyone knew their craft all permanent employees, safety was very important (2 story house, tile roof, early morning dew) Customer service was very helpful with regular updates from the office, organised grid connection wifi etc plus full rundown and problem solving tips on how everything works from their installation electrician on site.

Everything went smoothly. My first contact answered all questions and wasn’t rushed. I had a competitive quote and all paper work was promptly supplied. The team was punctual, polite, tidy and friendly. The system was explained to me and I have referred LMS to others.

Was easy to deal with LMS from quote to installation , On the day of installation the guys were on time and friendly and because they had an experienced team, each had their allocated jobs and got stuck into the install. I was surprised that the had the total job completed in about 4hrs on a very windy day as well. Cleaned up afterwards also removed an old sat dish for me. Was shown details about system and how to download app. I got a number of quotes they were not the cheapest but they had excellent reviews where the cheaper ones didn'tWould recommend to anyone looking for solar
No complaints. They were exceptional at every stage of the process. Highly recommend them to anyone looking to get solar work done.

Communication was excellent from start to finish.  I obtained a couple of quotes and LMs were the only ones who actually got up on to the roof to look at our existing panels.  installation was on time and flexible to my needs. Efficient installers and wonderful clean up afterwards.

From start to finish the service from LMS Electrical has been brilliant from getting the best price to a easy and professional installation of our system. Can't reccomend this company enough. Don't waste getting quoates from anyone else in this area, just go straight to these guys!

Was a pleasure to deal with LMS from quote to installation , On the day of installation the guys were friendly and got the job done quicker then forecastedWould recommend to anyone looking for solar and batteries

Prompt quote & very competitive price, with quality products!Wanted to support a local, Australian company - LMS staff were both professional & genuine, would not hesitate to recommend their services.
The whole process went well, installation was trouble free and done within the parameters I requested.
These guys are professional and easy to deal with. Explain everything I asked. Plus they have the best price.

After going through three different solar companies recommended by SolarQuotes, we finally decided to use LMS Solar and Electrical and we couldn’t be happier to choose the right company and the right team to install solar at our house. Luke was very patient and knowledgeable, he provided options that were suitable according to our household needs while also guiding us through the differences between each option. After much discussion, we’re confident that we chose not just a good solar panel & inverter brand but also a great company to install the panels.The installation team, Tony and crew, were very polite and attentive. They answered all our questions and concerns patiently, not in a rush-quick way. Something that we noticed was they also cleaned the debris (not just on the roof but also inside the house where they had to check the roof via the access panel) after they finished installing the panels. There was a time when we were concerned as the panels seemed not to fit our roof but we thought we would ask about it later after they finished work, however, one of the team members took notice of it and kindly explained that one of the panels was moved to the west-facing roof because the latter has more space for the panels. I think that’s a great customer service on-site, most workers won’t be bothered observing small things like that.Post installment, one of the team members stayed to explain how the inverter works and how to manage & monitor via the app. All our questions were answered promptly without a fuss. They also changed the electrical switchboard to a safer one.We’re more than satisfied and certain that we can always reach out to LMS again should we have concerns or any solar/electrical project in the future. Thank you Luke and team for the great work!
Accurate, fast quotation, very cost competitive for the quality of the proposed system. Quick install with no issues, on time, nothing we needed to do. can recommend.

The end-to-end process from quotation to install and connectivity was seamless, we were well informed & supported throughout the whole process. The designer (Luke), salesperson (Ray), installers (Tony & Team) and support staff (Kiara) at LMS Electrical were professional, communicated well and the took time to explain the design option up front (and didn't auto default & push the standard 6.6kW system like other vendors did). Our system (whilst early days) is working better than expected. I am extremely happy with the service provided by LMS and would definitely recommend them to others.

From start to finish LMS Electrical were professional, offered a range of options including panels and inverters, competitive pricing . Both salesman and installer offered unbiased advice and were most helpful with regards to minor queries post installation. We were very happy with the service provided by LMS..

The quote was completed really quickly. I did have follow-up questions and they were all answered.On the installation day, the installation team was polite and got the job done. There was a minor issue with the smart meter recording, however, this was dealt with.  Having a local company that is responsive was something I valued in case there are any follow-up issues. I am happy with the service from the team.

Everything with LMS Electrical has been A+++. From the starting process of quoting and discussing different options, to understanding what I was trying to achieve for other projects as well that I am working on (all that consume power), to the installation, tidy up... it all has been simply amazing.I live on acerage on a very rocky property. I was shocked to discover that one of the installers was frantically trying to find a small screw that he had dropped so that it didn't get caught up in the mower. Most people would certainly not go to that extent and just would have not even bothered about something like that. That small little thing certainly made me realise that this company has their customers best interests from start to finish.I ended up getting eight quotes in the end (bit overkill, but it was partly to do with certain panel brands I was looking at). LMS Electrical stood out substantially from the rest. The care to detail and not just providing another quote as many of them do. I highly recommend LMS Electrical, so much so that I left this review! It takes one super amazing experience for myself to leave a review.

From wo to go, we could not fault LMS,The knowledge, understanding and patience was exceptional especially from Luke, who is a qualified Sparky,so the process of the customer understanding the process was more easier.The Crew turned up on time introduced themselves, reiterated what the job was and how long no power, they were very professional and dedicated hard working crew and cleaned up after finished.showed me how to use solarweb app. Very happy overall.Would highly recommend LMS

The quote was very professional and covered any questions that I had, the install team turned up on time and removed the old system and the new one installed  in good time. They stayed back well after sunset to clean up and ensure correct operation of the solar system including the EV charger.

LMS Electrical are by far the best company to deal with when it comes to solar and battery advice and installation.Luke, Tony, Brett & the team are extremely knowledgeable and ready to give great advice in layman's terms, they really do know their stuff !They upgraded our switchboard for 3 phase, installed a 10Kw inverter and solar system, and a year or so later we have just fitted a 19.2Kwhr battery to our system, and we couldn't be happier, as a tradie myself I have seen more electrical installations than I can remember and LMS's work is up there with the neatest and best I have seen, when other electricians are asking who did the meter box upgrade and commenting on the quality of work you know it's a good job, and I'm not just talking about the stuff you see, the way the run their cables and workmanship behind the board are top notch, I can't praise them enough.The price listed includes all of the work LMS performed, installing a completely new meter box, components and wiring with the upgrade to 3 phase allowing us to feed in up to 10kw/h, the complete install of the Sungrow Hybrid inverter and panels on a 2 storey house, and the later install of the 19.2kwh Sungrow battery system.You may shop around for the best price, but what price can you put on service and workmanship like LMS provide?Do not hesitate to call them for your complete system installations and upgrades, these guys are the best by a mile!

From the start when Luke provided a quote he and his team's service was above and beyond! His team is very polite and courteous and they did extra work for me without me asking and knowing it had to be done. Their work iwas of high quality and they did the organisating to connect to the grid as well. The system is working very well and I have no issues with it. The team was punctual at all times and they did exactly what they said they will do; I will definitely use them again in the future. Thank you so much!
The sales process and the installation was very good.  We have been pleased with the process and the solar.We have recommended LMS Electrical to friends and family

Luke and his team have done multiple solar installations for me and they have always been honest and reliable. Luke is very easy to communicate with and always clear and prompt with his replies. The entire process has always been handled professionally and the team are always polite and lovely to deal with. I haven't had any issues with the workmanship or equipment, and any minor problems have been immediately rectified without any hassles.
The team were professional and punctual and the install went smoothly. Our system has significantly reduced our energy bills. Highly recommend LMS Electrical.

We had LMS supply & install a Fronius Symo 10, 32xRisen panels for $13k back in March 1st 2020.Luke and the Team were nothing but professional & easy to deal with at the time and has definitely been one of the best investments we have made for our family.Would totally recommend LMS Electrical for any of your solar needs, you won’t be disappointed.
Excellent service, excellent quality of the job installation, excellent value

As an IT professional who values providing top-notch service to clients, it was a pleasant change to experience great service from LMS Electrical.From start to finish, my entire experience was without fault. The LMS team is not only knowledgeable, they are passionate about what they do, and doing it right. Trust in the installed equipment and quality work is crucial for any investment, including solar. I have that trust with what LMS has delivered and that is priceless.I have no hesitation in recommending Luke and the LMS team to anyone who needs their solar needs taken care of!

Highly recommend the team from LMS Electrical. clear and easy to understand information up front on my options for an EV charger to work with my current solar system.  Once selected the install was quick and on time, with lots of friendly advice and tips on the day on the most effective operation of the unit.Thanks LMS.
Customer service is amazing, great job done with the install and tidying up our meterbox as part of it.

New house purchased, energy prices going up… so it made simple sense… Let’s install a large solar panel set up and battery system.The issue was… the solar and battery industry is quite fickle. After obtaining 6 quotes among the industry with various prices, options and quality… we almost gave up. It was all a bit too confusing & varied… we were getting contacted by salesmen after salesmen with varied quotes.Then we spoke to Luke at LMS electrical. Any investment needs due diligence completed of value for money, but also confidence in the products offered and most importantly communication.First of all, Luke and his team are the installers. No getting sold to by a salesman then pushed along the chain to another team to do installation.Luke explained anything and everything and his honest, reliable and professional yet down to earth attitude gave us the confidence that we found the company for our job.Installation day was fast, efficient and conducted by a respectful crew of workers.We are now successfully set up, no more power bills, credit back instead!!!Superior service, superior communication, superior end result.Would recommend LMS electrical to anyone looking to beat the energy retailers.
Luke and the team were very easy to deal with, and were happy to answer all my questions. I'm very happy with the whole process from start to finish.

It was so smooth from start to finish Luke and his team where great completed the job in one daycouldn't ask for better job WOW .What can i say if you want a Solar  go with LMS speek to Luke and i'am sure you be looked aftera 100% Profesional Team .

Luke was very ponctual during few weeks of me deciding on with who to go for my solar needs. Always replied on my messages, even on Sundays or evenings. No pressure tactics at all.Clearly described the panels, inverter, what can they do and what they cannot. Contrary to others.Toni and install team was a fun bunch, but never the less polite, punctual, tidy and job well done.Highly recommend for your solar needs.
Extremely professional, awesome price and kept in touch throughout the installation. Set up the app and also cleaned up after themselves.
Great service and professional install. Unlike most sparkeys, they actually cleaned up after themselves and took away all the rubbish, thanks guys

How was the sales/quoting process?Very good.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy?Polite and tidy.Punctual?YesHow was the customer service?  Very good.  e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install?   I had to organise the grid connection and exchange of meter to a bidirectional meter.They solar installer explained as much as they could to me about the installation and the smart meter, inverter setup.  They showed me in the app for the inverter and as I had a smart meter installed they showed me the energy  consumption and solar generation.

Had my old system decommissioned and a brand spanking new one installed by LMS.Highly recommended and I had many other quotes including the "too good to be true" offers.Quote was done quickly including plan for installation photo. I had an idea of what I wanted and it was easy to work with Luke on that.Great communication, spot on with turning up and getting the job done.Awesome deal for a premium job done.Great team arrived early on the day and by mid afternoon my new 10.7kw panels with 8kw inverter was humming along.I had a smart metre installed with a Sungrow inverter and Longi 370w panels, very glad I did. Rocking at just over 7kw midday today ????. Luke is great to deal with and answers all enquiries in very good time. Thank you LMS!!!
Luke is very knowledgable and quoted me for an ideal system for our needs within our budgetHis staff were punctual tidy and politeNothing was too much troubleI would recommend

Absolute champions!I have contacted and got quotes from 10 installers and decided to go with LMS. I found and contacted LMS on Facebook, Luke answered all the initial questions I had and provided all the additional information I asked for.Luke was great through the quote process, worked with me on different layout and system size options, different panel and inverter options. Easy going, no pushy sales tactics, not trying to make you sign up on the spot or push you into a certain product (so do own research on the brands you want, plenty of resources available) but was happy to consult on the products when asked.He then sent a quote for me to consider, the pricing was not the cheapest, but very competitive. When I said that I was happy with the offer Luke came out for a site visit to check out the building, measure the roof to make sure proposed layout would work and to look at the existing setup including meters and distribution board to ensure there would be no surprises on the day of the install.Once it was all confirmed and I gave the green light Luke confirmed that the install would take place 2 weeks later. I had a few extra questions and requests after that and Luke answered everything and supplied the info, like datasheets, that I was requesting. One day before the install I received the reminder and the time when LMS team was going to arrive. Next morning LMS team arrived on time, took the old system down in almost no time and started work on the new system. The 2-string 25-panel system on a multi-face roof was up and running by about 3 pm-ish and I even managed to get some power out of it on the same day :).The LMS guys were polite and professional. They set the system up, brought it up online, helped me set up the online monitoring account and the app on the phone. They explained bits and pieces throughout the install as the system was going up, consulted on where I wanted inverter fitted and on other bits as the install progressed. The power was out for a short time and they worked around me and gave plenty of notice before shutting the power down. Once finished they tested everything before leaving, left everything clean and tidy, stacked old panels where I asked them to. The inverter install is very clean, no exposed wires or conduits, neat install job. Panels on the roof look neat and tidy as well.I'm happy with LMS and would recommend the guys for Solar upgrades or new installs any day. The system is running and performing well.It's only been 10 days from the install, so it's a bit early for me to comment on any long term items such as post-install service, long term install quality (e.g. it didn't rain yet, but I hope there will be no issues) or long term system performance or the individual components. I trust it will all be well and I'll keep updating the review progressively as the things develop.
Very competitive pricing for a high quality system, easy to deal with, organised all approvals, clean tidy and helpful, happy to answer any questions prior to deciding upon them.
Quote was very good and quick.Installation was great and came on time and finished on time.Customer service has been great. Still awaiting grid connection.
